items.author: how-are-u.bsky.social
items.context: I play like 3 or 4 PC games, all at least 5 years old if not far older. I'm very glad to be content with that because yeesh, who has that kind of money to spend?
items.text: Nothing wrong with that, old PC games hold up and most run fine on modest hardware. A lot of the classics are sold DRM-free on GOG too, so you keep the installer.
